description: This file defines the OAuth2ClientsViewEdit class, which extends the ViewEdit class to manage editing views for OAuth2 client entries within the SuiteCRM project. It handles setting view types based on grant types and user actions.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing OAuth2 client configurations within SuiteCRM, managing different view types based on grant types and HTTP request actions.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Sets the view type and then retrieves the metadata file, overriding the parent method.

methods.name: setViewType
methods.description: Determines the form view type and form name based on the OAuth2 client's grant type or the current action request.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Sets the form name for the view and calls the parent display method to render the UI.
